core-js, 20,206 B on the integration_google-personalSettings page: polyfills for browsers older than the build targets.
5,840 B in 1 piece of 1 file have no owner: no mapping covers them, and the code matches no file of a neighbouring module, of the app, or of the bundler and its plugins.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (39 packages, 400 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
